title.en: 7.5 kW stays on the B500S-83D vs Electric 10 Concrete Pump page
title.zh: 7.5 kW仍写在B500S-83D和电动10系列混凝土泵有何不同这一页

description.en: B500S-83D vs Electric 10 Concrete Pump. 7.5 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: AC motor.
description.zh: B500S-83D和电动10系列混凝土泵有何不同。7.5 kW仍在目录格子里。插图来自「交流电动机」。

h1.en: 7.5 kW stays on the B500S-83D vs Electric 10 Concrete Pump page
h1.zh: 7.5 kW仍写在B500S-83D和电动10系列混凝土泵有何不同这一页

directAnswer.en: B500S-83D and Electric 10 Series are compact concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. B500S-83D lists a two-stage type, manual / electric, 7.5 kW, rated voltage 380 V, 5 m vertical, 5 m horizontal and 280 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor.
directAnswer.zh: B500S-83D 和电动10系列是河北品锦机械在邢台的紧凑型混凝土泵。B500S-83D 标出两级结构、手动/电动、7.5 kW、额定电压 380 V、垂直 5 m、水平 5 m、280 kg。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor. The image subject is Ac elektromotor robuster asynchronmotor. B500S-83D and Electric 10 Series are compact concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Dimensions: B500S-83D lists 915 × 550 × 550 mm. Electric 10 Series lists 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Electric 10 Series lists entries that B500S-83D does not: Theoretical output 21 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure 23 MPa. Hopper capacity 0.1 m³. Horizontal pumping distance 25 m. Max. aggregate size 2 cm and below. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor。画面内容是Ac elektromotor robuster asynchronmotor。B500S-83D 和电动10系列是河北品锦机械在邢台的紧凑型混凝土泵。电机功率：B500S-83D标出 7.5 kW；电动10系列标出 15 kW。电动10系列有、B500S-83D没有的行：理论输送量 21 m³/h；最大出口压力 23 MPa；料斗容积 0.1 m³；水平输送距离 25 m；最大骨料粒径 2 cm and below。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: B500S-83D lists a two-stage type, manual / electric, 7.5 kW, rated voltage 380 V, 5 m vertical, 5 m horizontal and 280 kg. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: B500S-83D 标出两级结构、手动/电动、7.5 kW、额定电压 380 V、垂直 5 m、水平 5 m、280 kg。外形尺寸：B500S-83D标出 915 × 550 × 550 mm；电动10系列标出 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。不要把目录里唯一写出的 380 V 贴到电动10这一行。

body.en: Electric 10 lists 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and 25 m horizontal, with no vertical line and no voltage. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Do not paste the only published 380 V rating onto the Electric 10 row. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 电动10标出 15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、水平 25 m，没有垂直行，也没有电压。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看B500S-83D请打开 /zh/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/，看电动10系列请打开 /zh/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Motor power: B500S-83D lists 7.5 kW. Electric 10 Series lists 15 kW. B500S-83D lists entries that Electric 10 Series does not: Type Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric. Rated voltage 380 V. Vertical delivery height 5 m. Horizontal delivery distance 5 m. Boom line Short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. Open /en/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/ for B500S-83D and /en/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/ for Electric 10 Series.
body.zh: 380 V 只属于 B500S-83D 这一页。B500S-83D有、电动10系列没有的行：型式 Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric；额定电压 380 V；垂直输送高度 5 m；水平输送距离 5 m；臂架行 Short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

question.en: Does B500S-83D list the same motor power as Electric 10 Series?
question.zh: B500S-83D和电动10系列的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D lists 7.5 kW. Electric 10 Series lists 15 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。B500S-83D标出 7.5 kW。电动10系列标出 15 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does B500S-83D list the same dimensions as Electric 10 Series?
question.zh: B500S-83D和电动10系列的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D lists 915 × 550 × 550 mm. Electric 10 Series lists 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor.
answer.zh: 不一样。B500S-83D标出 915 × 550 × 550 mm。电动10系列标出 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is type missing on Electric 10 Series?
question.zh: 为什么电动10系列没有型式？

answer.en: The Electric 10 Series page does not list that label. B500S-83D lists Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor.
answer.zh: 电动10系列这一页没有标出这个标题。B500S-83D标出的是 Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Where is the theoretical output for Electric 10 Series shown?
question.zh: 电动10系列的理论输送量标出在哪里？

answer.en: It is shown on /en/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/ as 21 m³/h. It is not shown as that label on the B500S-83D page. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor.
answer.zh: 标出在 /zh/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/，数值为 21 m³/h。B500S-83D页面没有这个标题。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_motor画面里印出的数字。
